dct_title_s: Delineatio sinvs illivs, qvem Hollandi menſalem, ſualingua Taffel Baje, nominarunt
dct_description_sm: The seas contain sea monsters, sailing ships, natives paddling a canoe and two compass roses. Part of folio map with Latin text on bottom. "The map also appears in Indiae Orientalis Pars, IX (Verhoefs voyage to the Moluccas, 1607-1609), by de Bry, published in Frankfurt in 1612, with a Latin edition 1607-1612." Top right: III. Bottom right: GK.
Title as given in Norwich catalog: Delineatio Promontorii, Quod Cabo de bona Esperanca vulgo vocatur.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997. Map 0205, p. 232.
